lines.en: Without having any idea of how to spend the evening, Noriko and I decide to further cultivate our familial bond by not sleeping together.
lines.zh: 不知道晚上该干什么，Noriko 和我决定用「不做爱」来进一步培养我们的家人情谊。

lines.en: At least not in the sense I'm most accustomed to, since we do wind up lying down and slowly drift off the moment we hit the mattress.
lines.zh: 至少不是我通常那种意义上的不做爱，因为我们最后确实躺下了，一沾床就慢慢睡过去。

lines.en: It's a bit risky given that Niki's living here again and has already walked in on us once. But I feel like it's much easier to forgive me in this context, so I don't think it will be a problem.
lines.zh: 这有点冒险，毕竟 Niki 又住在这儿，而且已经被她撞见过一次。但我觉得这种情况下的我应该更容易被原谅，所以应该没问题。

lines.en: Regardless, when I close my eyes, it almost feels as if I {i}am{/i} lying beside Niki. Just...more comfortable, I guess?
lines.zh: 不管怎样，闭上眼的时候，我几乎觉得自己{i}就是{/i}躺在 Niki 身边。只是……更舒服一点？

lines.en: Not in the sense that I'm not comfortable with Niki, obviously. There's just something about the way Noriko feels curled up against me that...
lines.zh: 当然不是说我和 Niki 在一起不舒服。只是 Noriko 蜷在我身边的那种感觉……

lines.en: I guess it just feels nostalgic.
I'm not sure which one of us falls asleep first, but I'd like to think it's me.
lines.zh: 我不确定我们俩谁先睡着，但我愿意相信是我。

lines.en: I think that would make her happy.
I hope that it makes her happy.
I hope that she is happy.
